{{Quote|Loruna must have a high estimation of your abilities to send you for this assignment. I cannot reveal the nature of the mission until you agree to participate. I can tell you this much: it's against the Drennics. Are you in? Yes or no?|Ha'adj to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:HE" />}}
'''Ha'Adj''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who lived at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was a member of the [[Azure Cabal]], a mercenary organization led by [[Loruna Scathe]] that operated on many [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SWG:HE" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> she was stationed in [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where she tracked the activities of several rival mercenary groups like the [[Drennics]]. When their actions impeded the Cabal, Ha'Adj dispatched a muscle to fix the situation.<ref name="SWG:HE" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ha'Adj appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Ha'Adj was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Azure Cabal|Azure Cabal questline]],<ref name="SWG:HE" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]]" update, on [[May 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="Chapter 6">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
